summary: A Yes vote enacts a one-half-cent (0.5%) countywide sales tax to fund wildfire prevention, watershed protection, and open space preservation.

tax.text: A Yes vote enacts a sales tax to fund wildfire prevention and open space preservation.
tax.quote: Measure B in Napa County : Sales tax to fund wildfire prevention and open space preservation.

tax.text: A No vote does not enact the proposed sales tax.
